Outer-measure obstruction analysis
techniques.description: Established that the product-outer-measure Fubini section bound (lambda*_n(E) <= integral of section outer measures) is the FALSE direction for non-measurable families (Sierpinski counterexample), refuting the proposed OuterMeasure.le_prod_outer helper for Erdos-Hajnal finite independence. Real crux is joint measurability of a measurable-hull family.
